purpose: Teach: 東欧/山道/ナレーション/サーブ/スーツケース/露天風呂/ピント/節分

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、東欧、絶対、旅行、絶対、行きたいわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'm being completely serious — I absolutely want to travel to Eastern Europe someday.
lines.style: Leaning forward with genuine intensity. Soft emphasis on 'absolutely.' Voice bright but unguarded, like she's been holding this thought and needs to say it. Natural pace, warm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、山道、絶対、ドライブ、絶対、楽しいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, honestly, I'm telling you — driving through mountain roads was just so much fun.
lines.style: Eyes alive. Quick, infectious energy in the delivery. Slight rise on 'so much fun' like she's reliving it. Animated but grounded, not performative.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、映画の、本気で、絶対、ナレーション、絶対、声、絶対、素敵だったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the way that narrator's voice came through in the film — it was genuinely beautiful.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Lingering slightly on 'beautiful.' Reflective tone, like she's still thinking about it. Genuine praise without overdoing it. Tender.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、テニスの、絶対、サーブ、絶対、習いたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I really do want to take tennis lessons sometime. I'm serious about that.
lines.style: Earnest request underneath. Lighter than the first line but no less sincere. Mild self-consciousness about admitting a want. Even pace, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、スーツケース、絶対、買ったの?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you actually end up buying a new suitcase?
lines.style: Curious, conversational turn. Gentle curiosity, like she's noticed something and wants to know more. Soft rise at the end. Natural, interested.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、温泉旅館、本気で、絶対、露天風呂、絶対、最高だったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that open-air bath at the hot spring inn was absolutely incredible.
lines.style: Warmth spreading across the words. A small smile in the voice. Contentment mixed with animation. Slower pace on 'absolutely incredible,' savoring it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お写真の、本気で、絶対、ピント、絶対、合ってないわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that photo you took — the focus was actually a bit off.
lines.style: Gentle observation delivered with a touch of wry affection. Not critical, just matter-of-fact. Soft and kind underneath. Slight tilt of humor.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、節分、絶対、お祝い、絶対、お店で、絶対、するわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'm thinking we should have a proper Setsubun celebration at the café this year.
lines.style: Animated and certain. Light forward momentum. Thoughtful planning underneath the brightness. Closing line energy — settling into a good idea that's just taken shape.
